message.content:
<think>The user asks: "生成一个包含 5 本虚构书籍的 JSON 数组。每本包含字段:title (string)、author (string)、year (int 1800-2024)、genres (1-3 个 string 的数组)、rating (float 1.0-5.0)。"

The user wants a JSON array with 5 fictional books, each with fields: title (string), author (string), year (int between 1800 and 2024), genres (array of 1-3 strings), rating (float 1.0-5.0). They want the output to be valid JSON only, no markdown code blocks, no extra text. So we must output a JSON array with those fields.

We need to ensure the JSON is valid. Let's create 5 books:

1. Title: "The Clockwork Dreams" Author: "Evelyn Marsh" Year: 1854 Genres: ["Steampunk", "Adventure"] Rating: 4.2
2. Title: "Echoes of the Void" Author: "Marcus Thorne" Year: 1997 Genres: ["Science Fiction", "Horror"] Rating: 4.7
3. Title: "The Last Ember" Author: "Lila Okafor" Year: 2015 Genres: ["Fantasy"] Rating: 4.9
4. Title: "Shadows of the Citadel" Author: "Jasper K. Lyle" Year: 1889 Genres: ["Mystery", "Historical Fiction", "Adventure"] Rating: 4.0
5. Title: "Quantum Rose" Author: "Aiko Tanaka" Year: 2023 Genres: ["Romance", "Science Fiction"] Rating: 3.8

Make sure years are between 1800 and 2024 inclusive.
